nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Cream with Squalane

avis.texte: Since starting my skincare journey Inhave tried several moisturizers, both drugstore and high end. This one is my everything. I love how soothing it is on my sensitive skin. Plus it's lightweight, but so hydrating. On top of it all it's refillable.

avis.titre: Beats out much more expensive creams
avis.texte: I discovered this product by accident when I was given a free sample with a skincare order I had made. I noticed that consistently my skin would look more radiant the next morning after using it. I have used it over the last 2 years and prefer it even over products that cost 5 times more.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: This product leaves my face feeling soft all day. I love the way it feels. No dry skin at all.

I bought their hand cream and loved it so I thought Id love this too. Nope. First its sticky. I have to wash my hands every time I use it. It also sits on my skin and doee not obsorb. Will not be repurchasing
A little of this goes a long way - very much hydrating! As someone who is always on the hunt for a great moisturizer- this does it and the price is not bad
I Love this product!! It's very creamy and hydrating and it's my go to facial cream!!!
Doesn't take much for the whole face, very light, no fragrance of any kind, and feels good--no more dryness! Best of all, it's clean!

I'm pretty sensitive and this cream hasn't caused any sign of irritation . The formulation seems to be more water base. It's not very thick and a little goes a long way. If you are looking for a moisturizer that penetrates deep without clogging your pores I'd recommend this product

The texture of this is nice and it is moisturizing. I liked the way it felt when I put it on, but unfortunately, it caused cystic pimples and seemed to irritate the rosacea on my cheeks. I've been using this since November nightly, but have now discontinued use. I also think it made the texture of my skin worse. This was the only change in my routine so if you are acne prone, use caution!
Highly recommend, smooth application, no breakouts. Dark skinned, Normal skin, not dry or oily. It gives in refresh feeling. None sticky. But it now.
I really like the whippoed, gel-like cream and felt it did a great job providing hydration, but due to the formula, the product gets used up in no time flat. One 1.7 oz jar will last two weeks.

This is THE moisturizer. It wears well under my makeup and doesn't take too long to dry and absorb into skin. Even on no makeup days my skin feels glowy and moisturized. The price is the only thing that hurts, but I say its worth it because a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: Honest review from a gal in her 30's
avis.texte: When I turned 30 I struggled to find a skincare routine that worked with my maturing skin like the products that WERE my holy grails in my twenties. I've started to feel fairly self conscious about wrinkles in my smile lines and one across my forehead because nothing helped them while also not causing issues elsewhere. Then this stuff arrived after I purchased it half off during March beauty steals, and slapped it on my face like Ive done so many times before and went to bed - it didnt feel sticky, or heavy, but also doesnt seem like a thick enough product to really penetrate, you know? But, hey. Id give it a go. Ladies, I kid you not, I stared at my forehead for a good two minutes the next morning. Its been almost a week, and im still staring at it. The lines have dramatically softened, and im starting to think that maybe Ive found my 30's moisturizer. This stuff is some type of sorcery.

I love kielhs ultra facial line specifically reg face wash and this moisturizer. It is basic but that's why i love it. I can layer it under or over anything and i know its not going to clash, irritate or pill. It absorbs well. I have combination skin that runs a little dry in the winter and a oily in peak summer and it works great all year long. I do have to layer with something a bit more hydrating when its really dry and cold. I buy the refill size, i like it better than the big jar. Not a fan of that tub packaging.

I was dealing with really bad acne, but I recently started seeing a dermatologist. All the acne treatments made my skin very dry. This moisturizer has saved me from flaky skin and hasn't caused my hormonal acne to come back. I definitely recommend it!
Possible formula change. Seems thicker. It caused me to break out for the month i started it and now my skin is clearing up after i stopped it. Clogs pores.
It is the best moisturizer that you will ever have. This cannot be replaced and there is no dupes. I HATE THE PRICE but never the product. It is my biggest HOLY GRAIL.

avis.titre: Great as PM hydration - Worth the price!
avis.texte: I purchase this cream in October 2025 and used it consistently only at night until mid Jan 2026 when I run out (50 ml container). Lightweight, deeply hydrating, and never greasy. This cream keeps my skin soft and balanced—totally worth it.

This formula is designed for a winter, non-humid environment. Its excellent for my winter skin, not for humid environs. I use pretty much every night from fall to spring and use lighter moisurizer in the humid months. I have mid 40s "normal" skin. This is my fav! So comforting.

I got this as a free sample when I purchased stuff as an online order. I tried it out for a couple of days and everytime it pilled on my skincare by-itself if i used too much. For an expensive skincare, I would think it wouldnt happen and having too apply it a certian way for it not to happen is ridiculous to me.
I have super dry skin and live in a dry climate. This is light weight and is great under makeup
This is worth the price and it has my skin feeling so moustuized the next day. I put a thick layer on before bed and my skin thanks me.
This is worth the price and it has my skin feeling so moustuized the next day. I put a thick layer on before bed and my skin thanks me.

I am someone who loves to try different brands and products quite a bit. There are a few things I have consistently gone back to. This is one of those things. I have tried others and liked them, but this one is just perfect. The best, light weight consistency. Non greasy, does not make my skin oily. I use this nightly and wake up with soft, supple skin. I will never give this product up!!

avis.titre: too heavy/greasy for my face, but great for body
avis.texte: this would probably be great for someone with particularly dry + dehydrated skin, but mine is only mildly dry and only in some places and I found this to be too heavy. it works great on dry hands/elbows though!

As someone with dry skin this is my all time favorite face moisturizer. Gives enough moisture to let my skin feel hydrated all day without being greasy. I've lost track how many of these I've purchased over the years.

Used to love this brand but the quality has gone down while the price has gone up. A few months ago I bought a 4.2 fl Oz jar. I ran out so I recently ordered another. Just look at the size difference!!! Such a complete rip off. Scamming the customers for sure. The quality isn't worth the money anymore.
I honetsly love how this is lightweight and leaves my skin feeling moisturized. I will say, idk if it's a full 24 hours, but it's definitely a good product.

avis.titre: the price is kinda killer.. but it does work at least.
avis.texte: I really do hate the price point of this moisturizer, but at least it works. it's creamy and thick feeling out the jar, but light weight and fast absorbing on the skin. it's not greasy or oily feeling on the skin either despite it being a thicker consistency. I dont experience any pilling or burning and my skin is really sensitive. I do notice a smell, but it's more of a chemical smell from the ingredients than a perfume smell. ill buy again, but definitely stock up on sales cause the price is a bit much.
I love this moisturizer! I had recebtly switched to cerave after using this and all I can say is that I couldn't wait to switch back to Kiehl's.
I had high hopes with this and their HA serum. It's nice and light with no fragrance but unfortunately doesn't hydrate my skin.

This moisturizer has been a godsend! My skin feels amazing, I have been using this for only a couple of weeks and instantly have seen a difference. I am using Tretnoin and this has drastically helped with the dryness from that. My skin barrier has been restored, and I will continue to buy this.
Best moisturizer I've used that was not prescribed by dermatologist. You do not need a lot. Provides long lasting moisture. I have fair sensitive skin and have mot had any issues. Used for 3 months.
I bought this for my husband and it has been the only moisturizer that actually keeps his skin hydrated for 24 hours.

The KIELH'S Ultra Facial Cream is amazing to say the least. This formal is hydrating, but not heavy, and feelsike you have nothing on after you apply it. I apply a dime size amount to my face every day after, applying my homemade hyaluronic acid serum. Yes, a dime size amount is all you need and your skin will never feel better.

avis.titre: Basic but so good for me
avis.texte: I have normal to dry skin, acne and sensitive. Im usually a Biosassance moisturizer but needed something a tad lighter. This was it especially during hot days for me. I usually get it on sale! The texture feels like cross breed with gel moisturizer and a heavy moisturizer. It does contain dimethicone for that slip. My skin was not irritated to it!

This has become my favorite moisturizer & have been using it for a few years now. I have tried SO many others but always come back to this one. I do have one other favorite but this one is best for me & for my sensitive skin, lightweight & soothing.

My sikn turns read very easily even if a product is for sensitive skin! But this right here did not disappoint!! Little goes a long way!!!! Definitely worth every cent! No irritation or burning AT ALL which is hard to find for my skin! Just made my second purchase.

I ran out a face cream I used to use and needed a face cream really bad and quick so I stopped at ulta and came across KIEHL'S face cream. I read the reviews on the ulta app and saw that it had many good reviews and its good for sensitive skin, so I bought it. once I applied the face cream to my face, I fell in love with the cream! I have sensitive skin so I always get scared if a face cream will start burning my skin but this was smooth, super hydrating, hydration lasts all day, and no smell at all which is perfect. This is my new face cream and little goes a long way!

This is a very reliable moisturizer for me. I already know it works for my sensitive skin and doesnt break me out. I dont consider it the most moisturizing cream that i tried but it gets the job done. Also works great under makeup.
This product wasnt as thick as I would've liked it but it absorbs well and is for dry skin. This is definitely an everyday face moisturizer.

This works real well for my skin. I've tried other products and none have worked as well as this one. It's a little expensive, but for me a little goes a long way. I have super picky and sensitive skin, and this was the moisturizing answer it needed. The texture is really nice and creamy, it doesn't pill, and there is almost no noticeable smell to it.
Emphasized my pores and blackhead, not worth it especially for the price point.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product is a miracle, I had undergone radiation treatment for cancer and that had left my skin super dry and after using Kiehl's after a week I've noticed a dramatic difference.
It's definitely a no-frills but quality moisturizer, so unsure why it's so expensive. Will be looking for other options that are cheaper but would pick up if a good sale.
I really enjoy this product cause i was suffering with dry skin and now it's super hydrating and soft. I like it's not greasy at all and there's no fragrance.
My daughter and I love this product. We do the 30min drive to Ulta in a different town just to buy it. Definitely beats the other creams we have tried.
I was a Peter Thomas Roth water drench cream fan for its light feel and hydration, but it's expensive. I thought this give Kielhs a try and I love it (and the lower price!).

I use to have to shave my face everyday to get all the access skin off because of my acutane making my skin dry, this moisturizer helped a lot. I was able to put on makeup with out it being patchy, it is VERYY thick and best for over night use.

Soooo I've got dry skin. This is a new thing for me as I spent 24 years having oily skin and then BAM you hit 25 and it's dry. Now I'm a black girl and if its one thing my momma taught me it was how to moisturize. I don't feel like this product does enough for it to be priced the way it is. I do not feel it offers superior moisture or leaves my skin looking better than my KPL LPS lotion. It's nice sure, feels great, but what are the real benefits that make it worth so much? I've been using this for about 6 months now and I just dont feel like it's giving me the moisture.
I love this product! Helps with break outs. I haven't broke out in months! And my face is so glowy!

This does give moisture to your skin but ive noticed it does peel up into little balls if you rub your skin and that drives me crazy. So maybe not the best under makeup. Its very pricey too! The lettering also seems to come off the container when using very quickly which is interesting.
I received a sample of this and didn't expect much, but wow. I am oleasantky surprised. It is very moisturizing and lightweight. A little goes anlong way. I will definitely purchase in rhe future.

I love the texture, but it wasn't extremely moisturizing. My skin is extremely sensitive, acne-prone, and a dry/oily combination depending on the season. Used this throughout the winter and spring, and didn't see an improvement overall.

avis.titre: This is my favorite cream ever made!
avis.texte: I love how this makes my skin feel not only today but every day after
I am so so impressed! I got it during the sale with 50% off and I am so happy! Leaves my skin so soft. The moisturiser is silky smooth, and doesn't break me out. Very pleased!

This moisturizer has been my go-to for over five years now, and it never ceases to provide my skin with the moisture it needs. Absorbs nicely. Never greasy, and not irritating. I'll never stop using it. I use it all year.
This is the only moisturizer that truly works for my facial dermatitis. It is a must for dry winters in Wisconsin.

avis.titre: Love it but the refill is different
avis.texte: I got the jar first and i loved the texture. Also, it is perfect for dry winters or locations. Hydrates perfectly. However, i bought the refill bag and i found that the texture was different. It was heavier and thicker. And im not sure about this but i had some reaction because some parts of my face were itchy and had small pimples. So im not sure if i got a bad batch.
Keeps my skin hydrated and glowing! Feels lightweight. I use it mornings and nights.

bought this because of the raving reviews and first thought was the price for the size is insane! la Roche posay moisturizer is 10x better and bigger for the price! second thought was it feels kinda greasy feeling on my face and doesn't really absorb that well. would I buy again? absolutely not. I bought on sale for 50% off and still wouldn't do that again.

Ok… im in love with this product! Hands down the BEST moisturizer ive ever used. Its so light on your skin and goes on super smooth. Leaves my skin soo soft and moistured. I have very sensitive, acne prone skin and this isn't irritating at all. Its just so expensive ☹️
With formula change now peeling is inevitable and is a deal breaker for me. Before this was never an issue but now seems to be.

I have combination skin so i have a hard time finding a moisturizer that doesn't break me out. I received a sample size to try, loved it so much bought a full size. Yes, it pricey, but a little goes a long way.

I really enjoyed using this. It's a nice consistency, not too thick or too thin and I find a little goes a long way. I have combination oily skin and my skin really drinks this up in the winter. My face does feel oily/greasy after a few hours though, and if I have flaky patches, it doesn't do wonders or anything. Good staple to come back to if needed. The search continues!

I use it as a night cream and my skin soaks it up better than other night creams. It might be too moist for daytime use, so I'd recommend buying the travel size first to see if it's for you, but I highly recommend it.
I ise this regularly it's part of my winter skincare routine nd has been for over 8 years.

avis.titre: best moisturizer for my combination skin
avis.texte: I have combination skin that is both dry, oily and sensitive in certain areas on my face. i'm so glad I made the purchase and tried it out. I use this product religiously and have seen so much improvement!
My dry skin loves this moisturizer, it also has great humectant ingredients. This moisturizer is amazing, it is my new forever purchase.
Although its a bit pricey, this is my holy grail moisturizer. Does the job and doesn't break me out whatsoever!

avis.titre: Caused major redness, irritation, and breakouts.
avis.texte: I was excited to try this despite the high price. I have combination skin- dry in the winter, but my forehead and cheeks can get oily. This product felt good going on, but my skin, especially my cheeks, turned super red after use and stayed that way all day. I decided to stick with it for a couple days to see if my skin adjusted. Within a couple days of once daily use I had bad breakouts, as well. I'm 41 and typically have clear skin. This also made my forehead extremely greasy feeling, even if I only used a small amount there. I'm going to return it, even though I like the eye cream that came with it as a free gift.
Feels nice & hydrates my mature skin. Works well under makeup.

I have the most sensitive skin and have tried brands from, the outset, first aide beauty, tatcha , inn beauty , sunday riley, etc etc. they all break me out but not this stuff . I glow and my skin is so soft and i never ever break out. Love it so much! Cant go wrong with this stuff!
This started burning immediately. It burned so bad I washed it off right away. So painful. I dont have any kind of skin condition. Never using again

I have had trouble with eczema on my face and after I bought a perfume and got a tester of the lotion and it made my eczema go away and then after it ran out, my eczema came back so then I went to the store and bought a little travel size of it and it's been helping my eczema so much. It's amazing.
The first time I tried this out was at the end of August in 2024 because I got it for my birthday gift. It's not greasy and it does the job.
I have been using this for 4 years and will repurchase every time
This unscented cream is light, spreads easily, hydrates, and feels so very good on my face! In the mirror, my skin looks smoother than before.
I have been using this moisturizer for the past 6 months and I absolutely love it. Right now, on the winter when my skin get's more dry this is a great product to have.
My skin is very dry and there are other cheaper alternatives that work better, however i did like the formula

avis.titre: Keihls is my go to now!
avis.texte: Love this product! It's so lightweight on the face and I love how my face feels after applying it. I am so prone to break outs so I was very hesitant in trying this produce but once I did I was so shocked and relieved with the results! Leaves face looking flawless!
got this as a sample for my birthday back in july. trust i will br buying again. makeup looks sooooo good with this moisturizer

avis.titre: Adding this to my every-day beauty product drawer!
avis.texte: I've tried a ton of products, and this is by far one of my favorites! Ultra Facial Cream is so lightweight but hydrates my skin like no other face cream I've tried. It's a little bit pricey, but I definitely think it's worth it!

This is very much an ULTRA cream. It was unfortunately very thick for me and I felt it on my face all day after application. I tried to use it for a week and experienced breakouts. If you have dry skin and need intense care, this would be great for you.

Less packaging which means more product for my money. Love this facial cream!!! I don't feel like my face is dried out when I use this and my eyes do not burn from wearing it like other creams I have used!

It hydrates very well and is non-tacky when dry. I'm still debating on whether it's making me break out (still haven't figure out what works best for me yet). For comparison, verse dew point gel also dries well, but I don't find it anywhere near as hydrating.

My flare ups have been driving me crazy over the past few months, especially on my neck, but this moisturizer made a huge difference! My skin feels nourished, buttery, and NOT ITCHY. My breakouts have decreased and im starting to glow again!

avis.titre: If this cream has no fans then I must be gone
avis.texte: I recieved this as a b-day gift from ulta and its totally changed my skin. My skin is extremely sensitive and hates most products. My skin was always oily and had dry patches on my nose despite using other moisturizers. Ever since ive started using this Khiels cream my skin is no longer oily, no more dry patches, super smooth and soft, and just overall looks healthier. And the cream keeps my face moisturized for days if i happen to forget to put it on. A little goes a long way as well and it absorbs quickly. Overall this cream feels luxurious and has completely changed my skin for the better. Its a bit pricey but completely worth it < 3

avis.titre: If this cream has no fans then I must be gone

My skin was always oily and had dry patches on my nose despite using other moisturizers. Ever since ive started using this Khiels cream my skin is no longer oily, no more dry patches, super smooth and soft, and just overall looks healthier. And the cream keeps my face moisturized for days if i happen to forget to put it on. A little goes a long way as well and it absorbs quickly. Overall this cream feels luxurious and has completely changed my skin for the better. Its a bit pricey but completely worth it < 3
I've been looking for a heavier day time moisturizer, and while i really like the way it feels and performs, it pills under make up making it unusable for me.

I went back to this moisturizer after Murad products were drying out my skin and leaving them with a burning sensation. This Keihls Moisturizer is great for my sensitive skin. Fragrance Free. I have combination skin so my face gets a little oily around the T zone with it. I use oil blotting sheets and the problem is solved. I love this brand
It was a staple in winter, but now it has Dimethicone and it pills under sunscreen
I've been using this product for about a month now and my forehead is filled of blemishes and pimples which I never get. Not worth it too expensive even for the smallest one.

avis.titre: This is my third time buying this moisturizer
avis.texte: This is my all time favorite moisturizer. I have very sensitive dry skin and as soon as I put this on after my cleansing, my face feels so smooth and well moisturized.

I got this as a freebie for my birthday. About a month into using it, I have had the worst acne ever. Like- cystic acne that hurts so so bad. I have never experienced this. I will never ever buy the full size product, I threw the freebie away. Hoping my skin clears up soon, this is awful.

avis.titre: My Fall and Winter Go To
avis.texte: At 36, I'm trying to retain as much moisture as possible; and this definitely helps! I use this along with the hyaluronic acid serum and the avocado eye treatment, and I love how my skin is make up optional as a result.

Just a few dabs of this cream goes a long way. It feels very clean and pure on my face. It is expensive but will last a long time. It moisturizes well, but I don't notice anything in particular with helping fine lines at all, is a good makeup base

I got a sample for my birthday and fell in love with it! I have sensitive skin, so it's tough to find products that are not going to make me break into hives. It keeps moisture in the skin all day, so you do not have to worry about replying consistently, and it's great to use before putting makeup on.

avis.titre: I'm looking but I'm finding it hard to replace this!
avis.texte: I tried this when it was at a great Christmas gift set price. The jars lasted me until September. I've started to look around for something new because I feel like I could find something a little more moisturizing. I'm 55 and I feel like I need something a little heavier. But now that I'm trying other moisturizers, I have a new appreciation for this one! It absorbs very fast, there's no added perfume, it's light and refreshing, you dont have to tug at skin rubbing it in like a thicker cream, there's no shiny face afterward. I have sensitive skin on my chest and it's never caused redness or any reaction at all. I even use it as an eye cream without any problem. I didn't realize how hard that is to find! I've tried and returned 2 moisturizers already and I hate to do that. If I can't find a replacement soon, I'm seriously considering just sticking with this!

I just started using this product, and my skin instantly feels smooth and hydrated. My foundation used to look patchy and cakey, but this product has helped prevent that so far. I'm definitely buying more of this!
This is now a staple in my skincare routine! I love this moisturizer!!

avis.titre: Great for tret users & sensitive skin
avis.texte: I recently started using tret & got a couple burns. This is so moisterizing, doesn't irritate my skin at all. Feels luxurious. A little pricey but I'll definitely repurchase!

avis.titre: Not good for dry sensitive skin
avis.texte: I got this as a free sample at ulta..used for 2-3 days with huge expectations but i hate this so called hyped moisturizer…my skin became extremely dry after applying it..also it caused skin peeling

avis.titre: Skin Transforming Moisturizer for my Rosacea
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin and suffer from papulopustular rosacea, which lately has been confined mostly to my nose. I have used Clinique Gel Moisturizer for over 16 years, but it started making my rosacea worse recently and burning my skin. I received a .95oz sample of this Kiehl's moisturizer from Ulta and was very happy with the ingredients list. I am even more happy with the results!! This moisturizer has transformed my skin. It's happy, clear and nothing in this irritates my skin. My skin LOVES this stuff. This is my new go-to. Even in the humid midwest summer heat, it doesn't clog pores and really does pull moisture into your skin. I'll be interested to see how it works in the winter but I am hoping for my best winter skin with this new product. 10/10 would change nothing except the price, but I'm saving money just by having healthy skin.

avis.titre: BEWARE if you have acne prone skin!!!!!!!
avis.texte: don't be fooled. I thought this would be a nice simple, fragrance-free moisturizer for my acne prone combination skin. after 2 weeks of use I experienced whiteheads, oiliness, dryness/itchiness/irritation, texture EVERYWHERE and deep, cystic pimples that hurt to the touch. it hasn't been as bad since, but it took me 6 months and lots of adapelene to clear the acne and scars. I looked it up & my suspicions were confirmed- this ranks highly for comedogenic ingredients!! be careful and pls spare yourself if you have acne prone skin. im sure its a great moisturizer for other skin types.
I use this as my daily moisturizer after I clean my face in the morning and at night. I love it!

Great moisturizer for combo skin. It did wonders for my dry patches, while still allowing my oilier t-zone to breathe. It's hard to find a middle-ground with many of these moisturizers, and this one offers just that. I also notice my skin barrier becoming stronger. All around an effective moisturizer that should be a staple in anyone and everyone's routine.
